Task: Batch Speech-to-Text

Write code that returns word or segment timestamps from a transcription result using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Amazon Transcribe:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_transcription_job, get_transcription_job
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 2 — Watson Speech to Text:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text

Option 3 — Azure AI Speech:
  Service: Azure AI Speech
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechRecognizer, recognize_once_async
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/speech-to-text

Option 4 — Alibaba Model Studio ASR:
  Service: Paraformer / Model Studio ASR
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Recognition.call, Paraformer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/speech-recognition

Option 5 — AssemblyAI:
  Service: AssemblyAI Transcripts API
  SDK: assemblyai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: transcripts.submit, transcripts.get
  Setup hints: ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/submit

Option 6 — Cloud Speech-to-Text:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: long_running_recognize, recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import boto3
import uuid
import json
import time
import urllib.request
import os

def batch_speech_to_text(audio_file_path: str) -> list[dict]:
    """
    Transcribes an audio file using Amazon Transcribe and returns word-level timestamps.

    Args:
        audio_file_path: The local path to the audio file (e.g., WAV, MP3).

    Returns:
        A list of dictionaries, where each dictionary contains 'word', 'start_time',
        and 'end_time' for each recognized word.
    """
    # Ensure AWS_S3_BUCKET_NAME and AWS_REGION are set in environment variables.
    # Replace 'your-transcribe-bucket-name' and 'us-east-1' with your actual values if not using env vars.
    s3_bucket_name = os.environ.get("AWS_S3_BUCKET_NAME", "your-transcribe-bucket-name")
    aws_region = os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", "us-east-1")

    s3_client = boto3.client('s3', region_name=aws_region)
    transcribe_client = boto3.client('transcribe', region_name=aws_region)

    file_name = os.path.basename(audio_file_path)
    s3_key = f"transcribe_input/{uuid.uuid4()}-{file_name}"
    job_name = f"transcription-job-{uuid.uuid4()}"
    s3_uri = f"s3://{s3_bucket_name}/{s3_key}"

    # Upload audio file to S3
    s3_client.upload_file(audio_file_path, s3_bucket_name, s3_key)

    # Determine media format from file extension
    media_format = audio_file_path.split('.')[-1].upper()
    if media_format not in ['MP3', 'MP4', 'WAV', 'FLAC', 'OGG', 'AMR', 'WEBM']:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported media format: {media_format}. Please provide a supported audio format.")

    # Start the transcription job
    transcribe_client.start_transcription_job(
        TranscriptionJobName=job_name,
        Media={'MediaFileUri': s3_uri},
        MediaFormat=media_format,
        LanguageCode='en-US',  # Specify the language code (e.g., 'en-US', 'es-US')
        Settings={
            'ShowWordConfidence': True  # This ensures word-level timing details are included
        }
    )

    # Poll for job completion
    max_tries = 60  # Wait up to 10 minutes (60 * 10 seconds)
    for i in range(max_tries):
        job = transcribe_client.get_transcription_job(TranscriptionJobName=job_name)
        status = job['TranscriptionJob']['TranscriptionJobStatus']
        if status == 'COMPLETED':
            break
        elif status == 'FAILED':
            raise Exception(f"Transcription job failed: {job['TranscriptionJob'].get('FailureReason', 'Unknown reason')}")
        time.sleep(10)
    else:
        raise Exception("Transcription job did not complete within expected time.")

    # Download and parse the transcript
    transcript_uri = job['TranscriptionJob']['Transcript']['TranscriptFileUri']
    
    with urllib.request.urlopen(transcript_uri) as response:
        transcript_content = response.read().decode('utf-8')
    
    transcript_json = json.loads(transcript_content)

    word_timestamps = []
    if 'results' in transcript_json and 'items' in transcript_json['results']:
        for item in transcript_json['results']['items']:
            # 'pronunciation' items contain actual words with start/end times
            if item['type'] == 'pronunciation':
                word_timestamps.append({
                    'word': item['alternatives'][0]['content'],
                    'start_time': float(item['start_time']),
                    'end_time': float(item['end_time'])
                })
    
    # Clean up: Delete the S3 object
    try:
        s3_client.delete_object(Bucket=s3_bucket_name, Key=s3_key)
    except Exception as e:
        # Log or handle cleanup error, but don't fail the main function
        print(f"Warning: Could not delete S3 object {s3_key}: {e}")

    # Optionally, you can also delete the transcription job itself:
    # try:
    #     transcribe_client.delete_transcription_job(TranscriptionJobName=job_name)
    # except Exception as e:
    #     print(f"Warning: Could not delete transcription job {job_name}: {e}")

    return word_timestamps
